content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am new to working with [product_name]. I began learning to program with it about a week ago. My setup includes three 4K monitors, and I am trying to find a way within [product_name] to adjust the font size for toolbars and icons. Most other software I use automatically scales its font size with Windows settings, but [product_name] does not seem to do this. As a result, it's very difficult to read menus and buttons on a large desktop. I am using Windows 10 64-bit, with monitors at 3840x210 resolution and Windows font scaling set to 150%. I appreciate any advice or experience you can share for newcomers. Thank you, [user_name]

Hello. You can try the following steps, which may solve the issue: Right-click the executable file for [product_name], choose Properties, select the Compatibility tab, then enable the option to disable or override display scaling for high DPI settings. You can choose between scaling performed by the application or the system.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing issues with the readability of [product_name] software on high-resolution 4K monitors, as the interface does not scale properly with Windows font enlargement settings. This makes it difficult to view menus, toolbars, and dropdowns, particularly in setups with multiple monitors and for those utilizing system accessibility features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to adapt its interface fonts and elements to match Windows display settings, similar to other widely used applications, to ensure proper readability and accessibility.
